title: the BEST package for the BEST show!!! thank you @Creative Goods Merch...
transcript: I've been on a work trip for a week and I just got home and I feel like garbage but Creative Goods sent me a package that has totally made my whole day Creative Goods is the absolute best broadway merch they’ve upped the Broadway merch game it's for one of my favorite new musicals of the season I'm gonna make you guess what it is based off this hat make it work purple have you got it yet? it’s real women have curves real women have curves is about a group of women who work at a sewing factory in Los Angeles in the late 80s and the women the majority of them are undocumented and it is just so beautiful and joyful and such like an uplifting show also really touches on the hardships of being undocumented in this country I loved it so much and I just you all you all have to go you all have to go and I have to go back soon and now I have the whole kit to do so so I got this make it work hat which is like get perfect color also a make it work mug honestly this is like perfect cause it's my first day back working since I got back from my trip I feel like make it work is kind of the theme of my life got socks! and look how pretty they are have curves like the stage and all of their art I think is some of the most beautiful like Broadways had in literal years like look at these flowers they're stunning a scarf! have you ever seen any more beautiful I can wear it you know like this very eurydice coded so cute wait I'm obsessed okay but also like if I don't wanna wear it I could frame it and hang it up because this is some of the prettiest art I've seen and then the last thing in here I think is a tote oh it's a massive tote I love broadway merch that feels subtle like obviously the color is not subtle but what I mean is like this is a real women have curves tote bag but it just looks like a pretty tote bag wow this is the best day ever thank you so much creative goods go see real women I promise it'll bring you so much joy this is the show we need right now in 2025 when the world feels like it's crumbling real women have curves it's doing the work it's making it work and I I really need it I have to go back I can't wait okay thank you
